title: Rent Stability Addition to the Retention Share, Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The time since the last rent change on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement adds to the retention share, counted in whole calendar months from that change's effective date to the handling date:

| Whole calendar months since the last rent change | Addition |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 5 percentage points |
| 12 to 23 | 2 points |
| fewer than 12 | none |

The last rent change date is the date on the rental agreement record: the effective date of the most recent rent change or rate-clock reset, or the move-in date where the rent has never changed.

## Edges (hypothetical last rent change effective 10 April 2025)

| Handling date | Whole months | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 9 April 2026 | 11 | none |
| 10 April 2026 | 12 | 2 points |
| 9 April 2027 | 23 | 2 points |
| 10 April 2027 | 24 | 5 points |
